gaps: Stock-take — no variance entered this week

issues: Covers were down 1,155 week on week and spend per head up £0.50, as Saturday was quieter than expected against last year's busy Halloween payday weekend (M11 KPI Report).
Sales were £252.20 down week on week and £1,430.10 (5.30%) under target, although lunchtimes are getting significantly busier (M11 KPI Report).
Deliveroo: every stat improved except prep time, which is still 11.4 minutes and well within green, so delivery is considered stable (M11 KPI Report).
Labour control keeps improving week on week but is still above target (M11 KPI Report).
Food cost was high because extra stock was ordered for a busier weekend than happened; ordering less this week should bring it down (M11 KPI Report).
Google reviews: fourteen 5 star and no negatives (M11 KPI Report); Inka agreed the earlier 2 star review can be marked as handled (England KPI meeting 03/11).

Staffing: a new FOH starter is onboarded and starts this week, the onboarding tracker is updated, O has booked three trial shifts for sushi and kitchen, and an assistant head chef trial is set for Friday (England KPI meeting 03/11).

Sushi chef recruitment is hard because candidates missed trial shifts or were not qualified, so Hannah reposted the job; Inka advised calling candidates directly rather than relying on Talent Funnel scheduling (England KPI meeting 03/11).
The building lift has been broken for months despite chasing Franchesca, so an extra kitchen person is needed just to move stock upstairs (England KPI meeting 03/11).
Inka confirmed the curry sauce must stay packed with the food to cut packaging cost and speed up service, unless complaints increase (England KPI meeting 03/11).
The scratch card promotion is being replaced with delivery to dine in conversion work (England KPI meeting 03/11), and scratch card redemptions expired around 23/10 (Admin Meeting 02/11).
The site could not record its GM/HC meeting without a paid tool, and Inka advised using the Google Meet recording function (England KPI meeting 03/11).
Maintenance: the grease trap needs checking to see whether it was fixed or needs a call out (M11 KPI Report).
Events: a Bonfire Night event at Abbey Park on Thursday could be very busy or very quiet, the Christmas menu is coming and a B2B event is booked for 19/11 (England KPI meeting 03/11).
Sales rose slightly but stayed below target, and £5 ramen and restaurant week discounts brought spend per head down to £18 (AM Updates 04/11).
